factors.name: Core on-page SEO: title tags, meta description, H1, mobile rendering
factors.note: Direct fetch of the homepage and five internal pages (services, about, contact, reviews, areas-we-serve) shows a valid mobile viewport meta tag on every page and one structurally correct H1 per page, but no <meta name="description"> tag exists on any of the six pages checked, and every title tag is generic with no city or service keyword (e.g. 'Home - Rock Solid Heating & Cooling', 'Services - Rock Solid Heating & Cooling'). Partial credit for what is present; the missing meta description and unoptimized titles are the main drag.

factors.name: Structured data / schema present (LocalBusiness or equivalent)
factors.note: One JSON-LD block exists site-wide (confirmed by reading its raw content), but it is only the generic Yoast SEO default graph: WebSite, WebPage, and BreadcrumbList types. No LocalBusiness, HVACBusiness, or any schema type carrying name/address/phone/hours exists anywhere on the site.

factors.name: Content depth: dedicated service pages, a location page, FAQ content
factors.note: Real, substantive multi-paragraph content exists for each service line (Residential HVAC, Light Commercial HVAC, Maintenance, Repair, Replacement), but all of it lives on a single /services/ page rather than dedicated pages, so it carries less individual search weight than separate pages would. There is no Princeton or any other city-level location page; 'Areas We Serve' names only three counties (Collin, Dallas, Tarrant) and never once names Princeton, the city the business is headquartered in. No formally labeled FAQ section exists, though a running feed of real, specific technical notes from the owner (e.g. damper systems, capacitor failures, R22 freon systems) functions as informal expertise content.

factors.name: Technical health: HTTPS, no broken core links, crawlable robots/sitemap
factors.note: Site is served over HTTPS. robots.txt is valid and permissive and correctly references the sitemap. The sitemap (rocksolidac.com/sitemap_index.xml) returns valid XML (HTTP 200). No broken links were found in the actual main navigation (all nav hrefs resolve to real pages). One inconsistency found: the www subdomain (www.rocksolidac.com/sitemap_index.xml) returns a 404 'Page not found' instead of the same sitemap, indicating the www and non-www versions of the domain are not fully equivalent for crawlers.

factors.name: GBP found and reasonably complete
factors.note: A Google Maps place embed naming 'Rock Solid Heating & Cooling LLC' is present on the business's own contact page, confirming a Google Business Profile / Maps entity exists under the correct name. Completeness (hours, category, whether the pinned address matches the real Princeton address) could not be independently verified without a live Maps UI session or API access, so this is Likely, not Verified, and only partial credit is awarded.

factors.name: NAP consistency across listings found
factors.note: Four independent third-party sources (Yahoo Local, MerchantCircle, D&B/Buzzfile, BuildZoom) all agree the address is 1254 County Road 561, Princeton, TX 75407. The business's own website directly contradicts this, listing only 'Mckinney, TX 75070' (no street address) on every page checked, and never naming Princeton anywhere. Hours also conflict: two independent sources (Yahoo Local and MerchantCircle) both list Sunday hours as 10am-5pm open, while the website states Sunday closed. This is a confirmed, cross-checked inconsistency, not a guess, so low points are awarded with high confidence.

factors.name: Appears in results for the primary local query tested
factors.note: Running the exact search queries 'HVAC repair Princeton TX' and 'AC installation Princeton TX' did not surface Rock Solid Heating & Cooling at all. The business only surfaced once searched by its exact name. Labeled Likely rather than Verified since this reflects search-engine-result presence, not a live Google Maps local-pack check.

factors.name: Review volume relative to the competitor set identified in this audit
factors.note: The business's own website displays 10 reviews directly (Verified, read from the page), and Yahoo Local independently lists 133 reviews for the same business and address (Likely, third-party aggregator figure, not re-counted review by review). No competitor identified in this audit was confirmed to match or exceed either figure. Not full credit, since the two counts found do not agree with each other and neither competitor's volume could be fully confirmed for a precise comparison.

factors.name: Rating
factors.note: 5.0 average rating confirmed directly on the business's own on-site review widget, and independently corroborated by Yahoo Local's 5.0 rating for the same listing.

factors.name: Recency: at least one review in roughly the last 6 months
factors.note: Dates were not visible on the individual reviews pulled from either the on-site widget or the Yahoo Local snippet, so recency could not be directly confirmed. The site does show dated owner posts as recently as January 2026, about 8 months before this audit, which is adjacent evidence of ongoing activity but is not itself a customer review date.

factors.name: Owner responses present on any reviews
factors.note: No owner responses were visible on any review checked, on the on-site widget or in the Yahoo Local snippet. Absence noted with Likely rather than Verified confidence since not every review on every platform could be individually opened.

factors.name: Business identity stated clearly and consistently somewhere crawlable
factors.note: Name and services are stated clearly and repeatedly across the website. However the address shown (McKinney, TX 75070) directly conflicts with the address every other public source lists (Princeton, TX 75407), so identity is clear but not consistent. Partial credit reflects the clarity without the consistency.

factors.name: Structured data / consistent NAP an AI system could read
factors.note: No LocalBusiness schema exists anywhere on the site (see website_seo factor above), and the NAP that does exist in plain text is the inconsistent one (McKinney vs. the real Princeton address).

factors.name: Content directly answering likely customer questions
factors.note: No formal FAQ exists, but a running feed of real, specific posts (damper systems, capacitor failures, R22 freon systems, mini-split installs, commercial trailer HVAC) genuinely answers the kind of diagnostic questions a customer might ask, and the About page does state 24/7 emergency availability. Partial credit for genuine but unstructured content.

factors.name: No contradictory facts across sources checked
factors.note: Two direct contradictions were confirmed: the address (McKinney on the website vs. Princeton everywhere else) and Sunday hours (closed per the website vs. open 10am-5pm per two independent directories).

sources: Web search results for "HVAC repair Princeton TX" and "AC installation Princeton TX", 2026-10-07
methodology_notes: No Google Search Console, GBP Insights, or live Maps-ranking API access for this business; GBP existence was confirmed only indirectly via a Maps embed on the business's own contact page, and its completeness and rating/review count on Google itself could not be independently verified. Facebook access returned HTTP 403 and could not be read. D&B/Buzzfile employee and revenue figures are third-party commercial estimates, not confirmed directly by the business, and are not used in scoring for that reason. Review dates were not visible in either the on-site widget or the Yahoo Local snippet, so review recency could not be confirmed directly and is scored with Unknown confidence rather than assumed. An earlier incomplete pass at this business (superseded by this record) had concluded no website or reviews existed; that conclusion was incorrect, a live, independently-owned website with real reviews was found and directly verified in this record, which should be treated as the current and authoritative version.
